   AND grantee      = 'analyst_ro';

SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid)

set -euo pipefail

# 1. Lock the Teleport user to prevent further access (24h TTL)
tctl lock --user=eve.contractor@eproc.test --ttl=24h \
  --message="ALRT-0004: Unauthorized GRANT SELECT ON public.employees TO analyst_ro from 10.20.7.88 at 23:42 UTC"

# 2. Forensic snapshot, revoke unauthorized privilege, terminate sessions
psql -h localhost -p 5432 -U dba -d procurement <<'EOSQL'
-- Forensic: snapshot whether the GRANT actually succeeded before we revoke
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.quarantine_alrt0004 AS

       grantor, grantee, table_schema, table_name, privilege_type
  FROM information_schema.table_privileges
 WHERE table_schema = 'public'
   AND table_name   = 'employees'
   AND grantee      = 'analyst_ro';

-- Revoke the unauthorized privilege (no-op if the GRANT was denied)
REVOKE SELECT ON public.employees FROM analyst_ro;

-- Terminate active sessions from the suspicious source address
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid)
